qualification: Verity-protected root is evidenced against the assembled image by the verify suite. No suite in this tree exercises A/B fallback through the GRUB boot path, and I2 is additionally pending provisioned production trust anchors and tampered-bundle/rollback negative suites, so I1 is claimed on the verity evidence alone. The UEFI firmware is the machine owner's; whatever verification it performs is the platform's claim, not this project's (docs/design/security-model.md section 4).

physicalBoundaries.jtag: Generic PC platform; mos specifies no JTAG/SWD port and controls none -- debug exposure is defined by the platform owner's hardware and firmware.
physicalBoundaries.serialConsole: Present where the platform exposes one, with a login prompt only; no account accepts a credential (docs/design/access.md section 2).
physicalBoundaries.recoveryPath: Whole-disk reflash from external boot media through the machine's own UEFI firmware; open to physical access by design (docs/design/security-model.md section 1).
